status: controlled pilot completed; no accepted win; future powered acceptance study remains planned
domain: goodput-domain-v5.0; same physical cases as v4
objective: unique bytes of fully verified completed bulk objects per second; accepted partial payload never counts as completed goodput

training.comparison: same initialization, teacher, worlds, model and rollout; time-aware GAE in both arms; only progress potential differs
training.potential: CRC-accepted unique incomplete bulk bytes / (262144 * production_seconds)
training.shaping: r_shaped = r_raw + gamma(dt) * Phi(next) - Phi(current); terminal Phi=0

acceptance_for_future_powered_study.host_guard: no configured host receives zero CRC-accepted bulk payload during measurement

required_reports: whole-object, receiver-confirmed and accepted-prefix throughput separately
optimistic completion feasibility bound, without dropping cases
unchanged v2-v4 results and acceptance definitions
limitations: Changing the host guard defines a new acceptance version; partial progress is not exact whole-object success. Prefix potential does not fix infeasible whole-object horizons or guarantee better learning. Calibration and pilot validation are not held-out acceptance.
